entities.name: Slides Stardust
entities.description: A mage of Antausia who with Selena Mistencharmer defeated Mandrake Nightshade.

entities.name: Selena Mistencharmer
entities.description: A mage who assembled hordes with Slides and helped curse Mandrake's Mountain.

entities.name: Mandrake Nightshade
entities.description: An evil leader with dragons and pit lords, defeated at Mount Margalus.

entities.name: Mount Margalus
entities.description: The mountain where the final battle took place, later known as Mandrake's Mountain.

entities.name: Great Magus War
entities.description: The war on Antausia in which Slides and Selena assembled hordes.

events.summary: Slides and Selena assemble small hordes at Mount Margalus and defeat the evil Mandrake Nightshade with his dragons and pit lords.
events.quote: They defeated the evil Mandrake Nightshade with his dragons and pit lords.

events.summary: Fearing Mandrake's resurrection, Selena and Slides put a dangerous curse on the mountain.
events.quote: they put a dangerous curse on the mountain

relations.note: They fought together in the Great Magus War.
